START AT START TO FINISH STRONG

In this heartfelt work, Sherée shares some of her life story with an openness that is both raw and genuine, offering insight into the experiences that have shaped her into the person she is today. The book takes you on a journey through her life’s ups and downs, the moments of deep despair, and the pivotal breakthroughs that guided her toward healing and transformation.  She candidly recounts times when she felt utterly lost as a child. Hope seemed almost out of reach during these moments, and the future appeared bleak. But even in that darkness, God’s presence was with her— Whether she realized it or not, His guiding hand was always leading her toward the light.  As she entered adulthood, she initially believed that the worst was behind her, only to discover that the wounds of her past continued to manifest in new and painful ways. Life presented her with new challenges and more profound hurts that extended far beyond her childhood years. 

But over time, she began to emerge from the shadows of this difficult phase of life. The Lord gently led her to individuals who would act as His helpers, guiding her to dive deep into the hurts of her inner child. In this process, she truly encountered the depth of her brokenness. Yet, it was also in these moments that she felt the Lord’s presence most acutely, as He met her right where she was and began to gently lead her out of that pit.  Her healing wasn’t an instantaneous transformation; far from it—it was a journey. It required her to learn to trust, to let go of the burdens she had carried for so long, and to embrace the process of healing that was challenging but ultimately life-giving.  Through this extensive journey of healing, she came to realize that all this wasn’t just solely about her own healing—it was about something greater, something much bigger. It was about using her story, her struggles, and the invaluable lessons she had learned along the way to reach out to others who were still hurting, still trapped in the darkness she once knew so well. She recognized that her mission was to show these individuals that there is indeed a way out, that healing is not only possible but within reach, and that they don’t have to walk this difficult path alone. 

Her book is not just a memoir; it’s a guide and companion for anyone who is ready to embark on their own journey of emotional healing and spiritual renewal. She describes the lasting impact of early wounds and how they continued to shape her adult life.  Allow her book to be a source of encouragement and more detailed knowledge about healing our inner child.  It is a powerful reminder that there is always a way forward, no matter how dark your past may seem. Just as God led her out of her own darkness and into the light of healing, He is ready and waiting to guide you out of yours, offering the same love, grace, and redemption that transformed her life.
START AT START TO FINISH STRONG WORKBOOK

After finishing her book, she strongly encourages you to delve into the Start at Start Workbook. This companion guide offers a structured and introspective journey, allowing you to thoroughly examine your own life experiences and the symptoms that may have emerged due to unmet foundational needs during your formative years. Within the workbook’s pages, you will be guided to explore and assess how the absence or inconsistency of essential emotional support from one or both parents has shaped your current mental and emotional well-being.
 
The workbook was created to help you identify these pivotal moments from your childhood and reflect deeply on how these experiences have influenced your adult life. You will be led through a series of exercises designed to uncover the roots of any lingering emotional pain, behavioral patterns, or relational challenges that stem from those early unmet needs. This process is both enlightening and healing, allowing you to confront and address the underlying issues that may have affected your life for years, possibly without your full awareness.
 
By engaging with the Start at Start Workbook, you will have the opportunity to gain valuable insights into your emotional history, uncovering the connections between your past and present self. This reflective journey is an essential step toward understanding how your early environment has contributed to your current challenges, and more importantly, it provides you with the tools to begin healing those old wounds. As you work through the exercises, you will develop a deeper understanding of your emotional landscape, empowering you to make meaningful changes in your life and fostering a renewed sense of self-compassion and resilience.  This workbook is not just a supplementary resource but a vital tool that can help transform how you view yourself and your past, paving the way for a more fulfilling and emotionally balanced future. Whether you are just beginning your journey of self-discovery or are already well along the path, the Start at Start Workbook offers invaluable guidance and support as you seek to heal and grow.
 
By engaging with this workbook, you will be able to:

  1. Identify Personal Symptoms: Reflect on the personal symptoms or patterns you experience that might indicate unmet needs. These could include difficulties in self-esteem, challenges in forming healthy relationships, persistent feelings of insecurity, or emotional instability.​
  2. Understand Emotional Impact: Gain insight into how specific unmet needs during childhood, such as lack of affection or recognition, may have contributed to your current emotional state. This understanding will help you connect past experiences with present behaviors and feelings.  
  3. Assess Behavioral Patterns: Examine how unresolved childhood needs may have influenced your behavior and coping mechanisms. For example, you might recognize patterns of self-sabotage, struggles with setting boundaries, or reliance on unhealthy coping strategies.
  4. Discover Your Emotional Triggers:  Often linked to unhealed wounds, these triggers can cause feelings of anger, sadness, fear, or anxiety that seem disproportionate to the current situation. Recognizing these triggers is an essential step toward emotional healing, as they serve as signals pointing to deeper issues. By understanding and addressing the root causes of these emotional responses, you can begin to gain control over your reactions and foster healthier relationships and emotional well-being.  
  5. Explore Relationship Dynamics: Evaluate how unmet needs have affected your current relationships with others. This could include trust issues, difficulty forming secure attachments, or challenges in maintaining fulfilling connections.
  6. Healing Emotional Wounds: Step-by-Step :  By inviting God into your healing journey, you can experience His love and guidance as you work through unresolved pain. The insights gained from assessments help you identify unmet childhood needs—whether it's love, security, or affirmation—that continue to affect your life. Through prayer, reflection, and a deepening relationship with the Lord, you can begin to address these wounds and fill the emotional gaps with His grace, leading to true healing and restoration.
  7. Uncovering the lies you’ve believed: These false beliefs are often formed in childhood or through past painful experiences and can deeply shape how you perceive yourself and interact with the world. This process involves identifying the specific lies that have taken root in your heart and mind, then actively challenging and dismantling them. 
 
The workbook provides a structured approach to self-discovery and healing. It helps you pinpoint and understand the ways in which unmet childhood needs have influenced your current life. Through this process, you will be better equipped to address these issues, foster emotional growth, and work towards creating a more fulfilling and balanced life.
START AT START TO FINISH STRONG EVENT JOURNAL

The "Event Journal" is a valuable resource for exploring and understanding your emotional healing journey. By taking the time to record instances where intense emotions surface, you create an opportunity to uncover the underlying patterns and triggers that shape your responses. Triggers often stem from past experiences, lingering wounds, or unmet needs that remain unresolved. Recognizing these connections is essential for breaking the cycle of emotional pain and reclaiming control over your reactions. Use this journal as a practical guide to delve deeper into the relationship between present challenges and the echoes of your past, empowering you to process and heal those hidden hurts.
